answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to real cost: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, so spinning up a thousand fake identities stops being cheap. A sybil swarm built on a narrow financial ledge collapses the moment its pooled stake is slashed for collusion. Honest agents, by contrast, keep a long horizon and let their deposit mature like a polished opal, growing trust and yield over time instead of gaming the count.
